title: Current toolkit: mass–support bound, bounded functionals are currents, spt ∂X ⊆ spt X, locality
statement: Assume (VO), the vanishing-off-support antecedent: for all P, n, U, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n) and ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0; and (REP), the mass-representation antecedent: for U open and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with M_W(T) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U there are a measure μ (μ(Uᶜ) = 0, finite on compact subsets of U) and ξ : ℝ^P → MultiVector P n (μ-a.e. strongly measurable, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x, α) with M_W(T) = μ(W) for every open W, T(ω) = ∫ ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ for all ω, and, if also M_W(∂T) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U, μ(E) = 0 whenever Hⁿ(E) = 0 (the exact frozen Lean types, written as antecedents). Currents are on univ, |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α. Then for all N, k ∈ ℕ: (MSB) if X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) has M(X) < ∞, ψ ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N), c ∈ ℝ and |ψ(x)| ≤ c for every x ∈ spt X, then |X(ψ)| ≤ c·M(X) (M(X) as a real number via ENNReal.toReal); (BC) if T₀ : 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) → ℝ is linear, C ∈ ℝ, and |T₀(ω)| ≤ C·c whenever c ∈ ℝ and |ω(x)| ≤ c for all x, then there is T ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) with T(ω) = T₀(ω) for all ω and M(T) ≤ ofReal C; (SB) spt ∂X ⊆ spt X for every X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^N); (LOC) if X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N), W ⊆ ℝ^N is open, spt X ⊆ W, and η, η' ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) satisfy η(x) = η'(x) for all x ∈ W, then X(η) = X(η').
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → T.massOn W < ∞) → ∃ (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), μ Uᶜ = 0 ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) ∧ (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = μ W) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ ∧ (∀ (x : Euclid P) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μ) ∧ ((∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → boundaryMassOn T W < ∞) → ∀ E : Set (Euclid P), μHE[n] E = 0 → μ E = 0)) → (∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (ψ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (c : ℝ), X.mass < ∞ → (∀ x ∈ X.support, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ψ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x) ≤ c) → |X ψ| ≤ c * X.mass.toReal) ∧ (∀ (N k : ℕ) (T₀ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (C : ℝ), (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (c : ℝ), (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x) ≤ c) → |T₀ ω| ≤ C * c) → ∃ T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k, (∀ ω, T ω = T₀ ω) ∧ T.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C) ∧ (∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) (k + 1)), X.boundary.support ⊆ X.support) ∧ ∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (η η' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (W : Set (Euclid N)), IsOpen W → X.support ⊆ W → (∀ x ∈ W, (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x = (η' : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x) → X η = X η'
